name: Acid-carbonate reaction: hydrochloric acid and sodium bicarbonate

observations.summary: The mixture fizzes as carbon dioxide gas is released.
observations.completed: Carbon dioxide bubbles rise through the liquid.
observations.gas: Carbon dioxide is bubbling out of the mixture.

explanation: The acid reacts with bicarbonate to form salt, water and carbon dioxide gas. The generic executor uses the registered reactant and product ledgers to model the change.
